verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, so the axis applies. Its marketing shows users handing tasks to the assistant: drafting petition letters and briefs, extracting data from client PDFs, reviewing RFEs for deadlines, translating intake questionnaires, building exhibit lists, and using a Research Agent. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how delegation and workflow automation work, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond homepage marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Visalaw AI is practice-safe AI: SOC 2 Type II certified, no data retention, and built for confidentiality
Quickly draft petition letters and briefs.
Analyze complex documents and automate entire workflows.
Pull every name, date, and passport number from these client PDFs into a spreadsheet.
Visalaw 2.1 Update: Smarter, more efficient with Research Agent.
